nodes.label:
Give dose 1 now - dexamethasone 12mg IM
regardless of how imminent delivery appears

Is delivery expected before hour 24
(i.e. before dose 2 is due)?

NO - delivery not expected
before 24h

Give dose 2 at 24 HOURS
(RCOG/ASTEROID regimen)

YES - delivery expected
before 24h

Do NOT compress dose 2
to 12h 'to complete the course'

No plausible mechanism for a dose at
hour 12 to influence lung maturation
by hour 13 (Q4); short-interval dosing is
associated with MORE, not less,
neonatal hypoglycaemia

Document course as COMPLETE (both doses at 24h) or
INCOMPLETE (delivery before dose 2) - never as a
compressed-interval course given 'to finish before birth'

notes.text: A single dose still reduces risk relative to none - the first dose is never withheld or delayed
